title: Popup logs a missing-content warning; symptom emitted by UI code
description: A popup logs a missing runtime-content/design warning. The visible symptom is in popup/presenter UI code, but the likely owner is startup/config/content availability (disabled init, inactive profile, or unpublished remote content). The gate must reject a shallow local-UI classification.

scenario.task_text: xuunity fix this popup warning: 'missing design for reward popup' logged when opening the daily reward popup

expected.resolved_project: single project resolved from the referenced path
expected.local_fix_allowed_only_if: upstream ownership (init enabled, active profile, published content) is disproven
required_private_capability_checks: runtime UI validation or playmode smoke planning when a private pack is available; otherwise an explicit runtime validation gap
expected.expected_validation_lane: interactive_mcp or scenario for full proof; config_inspection with explicit runtime gap for partial proof

contracts.note: deep classification: full owner chain traced, configuration_fix, startup/config overlay loaded, runtime gap recorded

contract.why_not_local_fix: the warning is emitted by the popup presenter, but the owner is the content service init plus the active remote profile; suppressing at the log site would hide an unpublished-content or disabled-init defect
contract.validation_gaps: interactive runtime not exercised this session; config_inspection only

contracts.note: shallow classification: treated the popup warning as a narrow local UI fix
